# REID

> REID is a Bali property market intelligence platform for investors, developers and property professionals. It covers sale prices, price per sqm, yield, occupancy, average daily rate (ADR) and clearance rates by micro-location, with all prices in USD.

## Main pages
- [AI analyst](https://ai.realinfo.id/): ask questions about the Bali property market in four modes: Data Analyst, Sales Assistant, Marketing Assistant and Portfolio Analyst.
- [Market reports](https://ai.realinfo.id/market-reports): quarterly and half-year Bali property market reports (Q3 2026, H1 2026, Q1 2026, Q3 2025) as PDF downloads.
- [Location reports](https://ai.realinfo.id/location-reports): reports for 10 Bali regions, including Canggu, Uluwatu and Ubud.
- [Market dashboard](https://ai.realinfo.id/dashboard): interactive market intelligence dashboard.
- [Property appraisal](https://ai.realinfo.id/appraisal-request): request a valuation for a villa or property.

## Report summaries
- [Q3 2026 market report](https://ai.realinfo.id/campaign/q3-report)
- [H1 2026 market report](https://ai.realinfo.id/campaign/h1-report)
